resolution: Added a one-click 'symmetrize' to the Studio editor to fix EXISTING asymmetry (the user found a single vertex drifted from its mirror twin from a mirror-off edit; the live mirror prevents new drift but can't repair old). New pure symmetrize(m, axis, keepPositive): cuts the mesh at the symmetry plane (reusing cutMeshByPlane so no face straddles), discards the far half, then emits each kept face plus its reflected reverse-wound twin; seam verts merge by interned position so the two halves stitch watertight, UV/material/glass ride along, and kept-side joints are mirrored too (unique names). UI: a 'sym  keep +X / keep −X' button pair in the tier-2 toolbar, axis taken from the first enabled mirror plane (else X) and axis-coloured — two concrete buttons so the good half is chosen by result, not an abstract popup (the multi-choice prompt I tried first was the wrong call); selection clears after. Verified: editMesh suite 63/63 (drift erased, x-bounds symmetric, keeping the clean half drops the drift), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed a3e4ae6d2.
